location.name: Seattle, San Francisco, New York City

jobs.title: Abuse Investigator
jobs.content:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet.

About the team

Abuse Operations is the front-line incident response and remediation function handling active product abuse and fraud impacting Stripe and its merchants.

What you'll do

You'll play a critical role in safeguarding our financial ecosystem by investigating high-risk accounts and identifying complex patterns of fraud during incidents.

Responsibilities

  • Investigate, mitigate, and remediate urgent fraud incidents (e.g., ATO, card testing)
  • Analyze high-risk accounts to identify fraudulent merchants and card testing
  • Lead incident root cause analyses to identify gaps in current systems

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of experience conducting incident response in security, product abuse or trust domains
  • 10+ years experience analyzing large data sets to solve problems
  • B.S. or M.S. Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience
  • Expert knowledge of Python and SQL

jobs.title: Writer, Content Marketing
jobs.content:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities.

About the team

Our Product Marketing team's mission is to generate customer insights that inform Stripe's product strategy, and lead go-to-market for our suite of products.

What you'll do

We're looking for an experienced writer to develop data-backed theses and original content pieces about how startups and AI-native businesses launch, monetize, and grow.

Responsibilities

  • Own content covering revenue strategies and pricing models, startups, and new developments in AI
  • Coordinate with the demand generation team to identify opportunities for new editorial series
  • Pioneer new content formats for Stripe, including short-form content and multimedia projects

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role.

Minimum requirements

  • A strong writer with 7+ years of experience in journalism, content marketing, or related fields
  • An analytical thinker who can derive original insights from data and market signals
  • Skilled at combining various requests and feedback into a unified message
